The meetings will be held across Mumbai, Chennai, and Singapore through physical and virtual interactions.

Source: BSE

His resignation will be effective from the closure of business hours on December 21, 2026.

news.headline:
Jindal Capital promoter Manjula Aggarwal renounced 100,000 Rights Entitlements through on-market sales on BSE.

The renunciation comprises 15,000 REs sold on November 19 and 85,000 REs sold on November 20, 2026.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
Sagar Defence Engineering filed an updated DRHP for a ₹3,412 crore IPO, featuring a ₹1,200 crore fresh issue.

Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields' IPO was subscribed 38% on Day 1; Foodlink F&B IPO opens November 26.

Source: Business Standard

news.headline:
CRISIL reaffirmed Genus Power's Rs 4,927 crore bank loan facilities, revising long-term outlook to AA-/Positive from Stable.

Short-term bank loan rating and Rs 100 crore commercial paper programme were reaffirmed at CRISIL A1+.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
Deepak Fertilisers reported best-ever Q2 EBITDA and PAT, with revenue up 11% and PAT rising 84% year-on-year.

Key projects at Gopalpur and Dahej near 98% completion, with net debt-to-EBITDA at 1.5x as peak capex ends.

Source: ScoutQuest
